2609.09853.title: The Era by Eon Benchmark: A Generated Enterprise Estate with Exact Ground Truth for Benchmarking LLM Agents
2609.09853.paper_summary: LLM agents for enterprise systems of record cannot be evaluated on customer production data, and no existing substitute provides ground truth. We present the Era by Eon Benchmark for evaluating LLM agents that use enterprise tools. The benchmark is built around a complete fictional company. It includes product simulators, company-specific internal databases, benchmark questions, and computed answer keys. Industry, company size, business model, application portfolio, and a seed define each company. One seeded entity graph supplies shared company data to simulators of Salesforce, Zendesk, Slack, Gong, and other products. A questionconditioned generator creates the schemas and records for internal databases. It takes shared entities, keys, and values from the same graph before generating database-specific facts. Both mechanisms therefore describe one consistent enterprise estate. Every expected answer is computed from the final records, so grading is exact. Design and answer-key checks validate the internal databases. A realism scorecard and adversarial detector validate the entity graph. Across 23 generated companies, the mean realism score rose from 61.8 to 97.0, with zero records flagged as synthetic. In the reported simulator-track comparison, nine models answered the same 33 questions three times each. Accuracy estimates ranged from 42.4% to 76.8%, and three of 36 pairwise differences remained supported after correction.
2609.09853.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理人無法在客戶生產數據上進行評估，且現有的替代方案無法提供真實基準。我們提出了 Eon 基準，用於評估使用企業工具的 LLM 代理人。該基準圍繞一個完整的虛構公司構建。它包括產品模擬器、公司特定的內部數據庫、基準問題和計算的答案鍵。行業、公司規模、商業模型、應用組合和種子定義了每個公司。一個種子實體圖為 Salesforce、Zendesk、Slack、Gong 和其他產品的模擬器提供共享公司數據。一個問題條件生成器創建內部數據庫的架構和記錄。它從同一圖中提取共享實體、鍵和值，然後生成特定於數據庫的事實。因此，這兩種機制描述了一個一致的企業狀況。每個預期的答案都是從最終記錄中計算得出的，因此評分是準確的。設計和答案鍵檢查驗證內部數據庫。現實性評分卡和對抗檢測器驗證實體圖。在生成的 23 家公司的平均現實性評分從 61.8 上升到 97.0，且沒有記錄被標記為合成。在報告的模擬器跟蹤比較中，九個模型對同 33 個問題各回答三次。準確性估計範圍從 42.4% 到 76.8%，且在校正後，36 個成對差異中有三個仍然得到支持。
